note: The candidate HEIF declares an auxiliary alpha image with its own smaller ispe dimensions, and decoding materializes those input-controlled dimensions in alpha.
The decoded auxiliary image Y plane is transferred into the primary image as the Alpha plane while preserving the auxiliary plane dimensions.
The alpha source plane object, including its width, height, stride, and memory pointer, is copied out of the auxiliary image.
The primary image now has a heif_channel_Alpha plane whose dimensions can be smaller than the primary image dimensions.
Color conversion starts without validating that the attached Alpha channel has full primary-image width and height.
The conversion copies the primary image width from each alpha row, causing an out-of-bounds read when the auxiliary alpha plane row is smaller.
